Plot mapped and unmapped reads per sample

Source: R/qc.R
qc_plot_read_mapping.Rd

Horizontal stacked bars of mapped and unmapped reads per sample, with the mapping rate printed on each bar. Samples below min_pct_mapped are marked "(low)".

Usage

qc_plot_read_mapping(
  summary_df,
  meta,
  colour_by = "group",
  colours = NULL,
  facet_by = NULL,
  min_pct_mapped = 0.65,
  interactive = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
)

Arguments

summary_df

Count summary: data frame with columns sample_id, total_reads and mapped (see section 'Count summary').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

colour_by

Name of the column in meta used to colour samples.

colours

Optional named character vector of colours, with names matching the values of the colour_by column (e.g. c(Untreated = "#0073C2", Drug = "#CD534C")). If NULL (default), the RColorBrewer "Dark2" palette is used.

facet_by

Optional name of a column in meta used to split the plot into panels (default is NULL, no panels).

min_pct_mapped

Minimum acceptable fraction of mapped reads, from 0 to 1 (default is 0.65, the minimum used by MAGeCK-VISPR).

interactive

Logical; if TRUE (default), return an interactive plotly object, otherwise a ggplot object.

base_size

Base font size of the plot.

Value

A plotly object (interactive = TRUE) or a ggplot object.

Examples

qc_plot_read_mapping(exampleCountSummary, exampleSampleMeta,
                     interactive = FALSE)
